scope: 八类部件及空壳、六向透明预览、状态和四组合美术复核；实际游戏碰撞与装配待接入验证

requirements: held battery requires no existing battery
candidate.label: 位置可用，右键尝试安装

states.low: battery present && energy < 100; not equal to stopped
states.nodeActivity: per-node ACTIVE distinct from global off/working/waiting; passive wing/float and ignited rocket may continue when disabled

resources.spring: selected node springCooldown, 0..40 world ticks; zero does not prove armed

keys.riding: actual translated TOGGLE binding; W/S and A/D
keys.groundStop: sneak empty-hand RMB on control panel
keys.remove: stopped, sneak empty-hand RMB; burning rocket cannot remove; inventory must have room

feedback.scope: current target only; clear on target/held item change or bounded response display lifetime

visibility.hud: alive nonspectator HUD visible no screen within five blocks and target/riding same machine
visibility.ghost: selectedNode eligibility; hide on no target/screen/HUD hidden

deferredChecks: Minecraft native font and GUI scale
client synchronization and actual resource consumption
bottom mounting through floor and wheel gap
all possible multi-part combinations and actual collisions

ghost.sorting: global far-to-near across all3 original atlases
ghost.material: uniform mint; retain exact geometry including battery-window area, no active indicator tint

partRendering.battery: actual body or held charge, same adapted geometry/UV/window masks
partRendering.wing: fixed; per-node active shown in detail, passive even when off
partRendering.rocket: actual fuel0/spent -> spent model; actual active && fuel>0 -> existing cuboid flame; ghost has no flame
partRendering.spring: !ghost && cooldown>30 -> extended vertices; ghost compressed; active does not drive pose
partRendering.wheel: active && !ghost -> age*.4, rotating group; no reverse/distance-based assumption
partRendering.stabilizer: active -> mint; otherwise muted; no inferred amber failure; any actual active kind7 -> body roll0
partRendering.float: fixed; node active shown in detail, passive even when off; no lamp/animation/independent collision
